subject.title: Track OpenClaw seams needed for full imported-plugin parity

question: Which listed parity gaps should become stable, source-format-neutral OpenClaw public contracts, and should accepted contracts be split into individual upstream design issues?
rationale: The requested APIs expose runtime, approval, authentication, bundle-loading, and notification ownership; their permanent boundaries and sequencing require maintainer product and security intent rather than an autonomous implementation choice.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split contracts
options.body: Retain this issue as the parity index and create focused upstream work only for seams maintainers explicitly accept.

options.title: Prioritize a smaller subset
options.body: Select the highest-value seams first and leave the remaining mappings visibly unsupported until demand or host architecture changes.

options.title: Reject public parity expansion
options.body: Keep the affected imports unsupported and document that these source capabilities are outside the intended OpenClaw plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split contracts
recommendation.body: Retain this issue as the parity index and create focused upstream work only for seams maintainers explicitly accept.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical capability inventory and have the strongest available repository-level product context.
